title: ImageArtifact metadata (P2.1)
description: Metadata manifest for an imported image artifact (RFC-0006, image-import.md §8). Immutable, content-addressed. The exact original bytes are the payload; this schema describes the metadata. additionalProperties is implicit-true: the format is forward-compatible and additive-only under the RFC-0005 Schema Evolution Policy.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the payload bytes; content address.

input_artifact_hashes.description: Content hashes of input artifacts; import has no upstream artifacts, so this is typically empty.

configuration_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical importer configuration.

unit.description: "meter" by default; not applicable to raw pixels.

width.description: Image width in pixels, from header.

height.description: Image height in pixels, from header.

pixel_format.description: Canonical pixel format, e.g. rgb8, gray8, bayer_bggr8, float32.

exif.description: Optional EXIF-derived metadata captured as available (image-import.md §5).
